verdict.rationale: Snyk Studio documents a default hooks-based integration for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot, so code written by AI coding assistants is scanned "at inception". This is backed by a local MCP server built on the Snyk CLI that agents can call with prompts like "scan my directory for security issues", plus in-assistant /snyk-fix remediation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent hooks working, and detail on whether hooks block or gate code before it is committed rather than only reporting findings.
